scope: Synthetic contract validation only. No market prices, outcomes, models or production stores.

contract.source_of_record: massive_stock_day raw Daily bars plus existing Data OS reference.corporate_actions owner once populated from authoritative source events
contract.split_effective_rule: On execution_date trading is already on post-split share basis; apply split_from/split_to to prices strictly before execution_date and reciprocal to volume.
contract.decision_vintage_rule: Use only corporate-action events with execution_date <= decision cutoff. Preserve source snapshot/fetched_at separately; historical current-vintage use remains RETROSPECTIVE.
contract.geometry_basis: split-adjusted price-only analytical frame derived from immutable raw source; preserve original raw trigger/invalidation geometry and factor/vintage; no dividend adjustment in detector geometry.
contract.volume_basis: raw persisted integer volume transformed by reciprocal split-price factor when participation spans a split; preserve raw volume and factor.
contract.economic_primary: split-adjusted price return on the same price-only basis, with transaction costs separate. Not total shareholder return.
contract.economic_secondary: total-return ruler remains HOLD until authoritative dividend events plus an explicit entitlement/reinvestment convention and transform receipt are accepted.
contract.unmodelled_actions: spin-offs, mergers, cash/stock consideration and unresolved identity changes return CORPORATE_ACTION_UNRESOLVED rather than being inferred from price jumps.
contract.heuristic_boundary: scripts/replay_standout_pipeline.split_adjust is compatibility/diagnostic evidence only for TOI; its price-jump heuristic must not be the authoritative corporate-action source.
